changes.title: No wake tip
items: No more tip at the bottom of the screen once you're up: getting dressed and finding your decks are left to you

changes.title: Seven new trees
items: Seven new trees on the far islands: mesquite in the badlands scrub, desert ironwood in the red canyon, bald cypresses standing in the drowned wood, coconut and nipa palms along the mangrove coasts, and mopane and marula in the bushveld

changes.title: Telescope sliders
items: Test sliders on the pause page for the telescope: its haze (near and far) and its vignette, to try more colour in its view
